title: John's Life Experiences Quiz
shared_passage:
Listen to a conversation between John and Sally and answer the questions.

SALLY: Hey, John, do you want to try this quiz? It's called Have You Ever. I ask you some questions about your life. You get a point for every experience you have had.

JOHN: Er yes okay. That sounds fun.

SALLY: Right, so question one. Have you ever been on television?

JOHN: Yes, actually, I have.

SALLY: Really? When was that?

JOHN: It was last year. I was watching a big football game with my dad. The game was on TV, and the camera showed us in the crowd.

SALLY: What were you doing when you were on TV?

JOHN: We were cheering after a goal.

SALLY: Great! So, one point for you! Next question. Have you ever met a famous person?

JOHN: Yes, I have! I've met Nicholas Cage.

SALLY: The actor?

JOHN: Yes! It was about three years ago. I was in the shopping mall, and there was a big crowd of people. They were all taking photos.

SALLY: Did you get a photo too?

JOHN: Well, I had to wait a long time because many people wanted to take a picture. But I finally got a selfie with him. He was very friendly. I'll show it to you.

SALLY: Wow! Lucky you! I've never met anyone famous. So, two points. Next question. Have you ever broken a bone?

JOHN: Yes, I have. But it was a long time ago. I was about 7.

SALLY: What did you break?

JOHN: My arm.

SALLY: How did you break it?

JOHN: I was on holiday with my parents. I was running down a hill, and I fell onto some stones.

SALLY: Ouch! But that's three points for you. The next question is: have you ever climbed a mountain?

JOHN: Yes, I've climbed several mountains.

SALLY: Really? Which one was your favourite?

JOHN: Mmm, I think my favourite was Snowdon in Wales. It was warm and sunny when we climbed it. That's why I liked it. The other mountains were in Scotland, and we climbed them in the rain. I want to climb the tallest mountain in England next. I haven't climbed any English mountains.

SALLY: Did it take a long time?

JOHN: It took about six hours to go up and down.

SALLY: Well done! So, last question. Have you ever sent a Valentine's Day card?

JOHN: Mm, yes, I have.

SALLY: Really? When? Last February?

JOHN: Yes, I sent one earlier this year and one last year too.

SALLY: Who did you send it to?

JOHN: I'm not telling you!

SALLY: Ah! Well, I've never sent one, and I've never received one either.

JOHN: Poor you! I'll send you one next year!
